dialogues.speaker: Hedwig
dialogues.text: Frankly, I never expected the Honorary Knight to come and join this wargame as well. The setup here is quite the production...

choices.text: Friend, what other work do you do?

response.speaker: Hedwig
response.text: Joking, joking! Truth is, it's all classic clerical work. Whatever comes up, I'm the one running negotiations between the Knights, the Palais Mermonia, and the Natlanese warriors.

response.speaker: Hedwig
response.text: It cuts down on the friction cost of having too many people going back and forth.

response.speaker: Hedwig
response.text: Procedural matters during cooperation also fall to me to handle. And I manage the overall travel-and-expenses budget for the exchange team...

response.speaker: Hedwig
response.text: Well, here we are meeting, aren't we? And then there's our legendary marksman, Captain Chevreuse of the Special Patrol — known to put rounds within a one-arc-minute dispersion at a thousand paces...

response.speaker: Hedwig
response.text: And then there's the not-evaluable-by-normal-standards Saurian-rider Chasca — her marksmanship is so absurdly precise it's like she's got stabilizer mechanisms built into her hands.

response.speaker: Hedwig
response.text: No matter how messy or exhausting the work gets, I'm coming out way ahead. They could pay me a negative salary, and it'd still be worth it!

response.speaker: Hedwig
response.text: Plus, I've been finding the musket suits me rather well. After my injury, I'd given up hope of fighting with a sword again...

response.speaker: Hedwig
response.text: As it turned out, in the wargame I borrowed Koch's musket and had a few goes at the scenarios — the results were pretty respectable. Maybe I'll be able to return to the front lines with this weapon someday!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The crowd doesn't seem all that big, though?

response.speaker: Hedwig
response.text: By the standards of the early technical exchange meetings, this is a serious turnout! It's a mixed deployment from the Ranged, Support, and General Affairs Companies!

response.speaker: Hedwig
response.text: And if our good Vice Captain of the Fifth Company hadn't begged off with some peculiar excuse, the Knights' presence alone would be enough to wipe out a sizable monster outfit.

response.speaker: Hedwig
response.text: To say nothing of the Fontaine Captain and the Natlanese Saurian-riders we've got here as well!

choices.text: Best of luck to you, then.
Don't let me keep you. I'll be off.

response.speaker: Hedwig
response.text: You're the busy one — being so polite to me, I'm flattered!

dialogues.speaker: Koch
dialogues.text: Almost done for the day... fancy a couple of drinks at The Rusty Rudder over there?

dialogues.speaker: Hedwig
dialogues.text: Drinks!? You'd be paying out of your own pocket, then? I'm not approving a single Mora for it.

dialogues.speaker: Koch
dialogues.text: All good — we'll cover it ourselves, and bring a few good bottles back for Horken, Ursula, and Gunther! Oh, and Captain Kaeya and the Grand Master too!

dialogues.speaker: Hedwig
dialogues.text: Count me out, regardless. I've got to organize the records from this wargame properly, and the Ranged Company has to leave someone behind to help me!

dialogues.speaker: Hedwig
dialogues.text: And there's the Special Patrol's written documentation for the Grand Master, the study-exchange plan... we've gone and made another fine start to something without even meaning to!
